# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens in parallel belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (min, max, and default seconds), or `indefinite` (runs until the person stops it manually). A **startTrigger** ties a step to the program clock or to another step—`programStart` (at t=0), `programStartOffset` (at a specific offset), `afterStep` (when another step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when another step ends plus a delay), `manual` (the person taps to start), `onAbort` (only if another step is aborted), or `compound` (a logical combination of triggers). `stepId`s must be unique across the WHOLE program, not just per track, so every step is globally addressable. Every `task` that a step occupies must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry, and that entry's `maxConcurrent` enforces how many steps can use that task at once—one oven, one thermocycler, one griddle. Work repeated n times (n trays baking, n samples spinning, n aircraft taxiing) is declared as `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on a single step—never as n hand-copied steps or tracks. Chain what follows each repetition with `{"type":"afterStep","stepId":"<step>","instances":"each"}` to make it replicate too; give the step that waits for all instances `{"instances":"all"}`; and when the holding area between them only fits k at a time (a cooling rack holding two trays, a rotor holding six tubes, a taxiway holding two aircraft) set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` so the upstream step is held back instead of stranding the downstream one.

For this breakfast recipe, I expect the following resource constraints:

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps to clock or to other steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are globally unique; replicates describe repeated work on one step, not copied tracks",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "griddle", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "toaster", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "coffeemaker", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "grinder", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "oven", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "prep", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
